en.title: How surgeons hold bone with plates and screws

sentences.text: After a jaw is cut in surgery, the pieces must stay still while the bone heals.
The surgeon lines up the pieces. Then they bend a thin titanium plate to fit the bone.
A drill makes a hole straight through the plate, with cool water running over it.
Short screws hold the plate, two on each side of the cut.
They go only into the hard outer layer of bone, away from the tooth roots and the nerve.
